The object cue borrows from scroll tradition and the modern scroll-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as scroll-coded rather than literal.

What separates the Scroll emoji from the rest of the book-paper family is the specific scroll register. The emoji is not saying 'generic book-paper' but rather 'scroll-coded scroll,' which carries a specific object, book-paper, or reference specificity.

Skip the Scroll emoji in sympathy, condolence, or break-up contexts. The scroll-coded cue is the wrong register for somber moments. A quiet ❤️ or a sentence that acknowledges the moment is a better fit.
